preparation.scope: Only ordinary training-goal diversity expands. Frozen query rows, labels, full candidates, reserved closures, source identities and physical transitions verified before optimizer launch.

scope: Matched4000-update target-diversity phases are complete. Original frozen query rows and candidate closures unchanged. Expanded goals improve two-step held planning but still fail its test gate and regress fixed21/24/switch performance; adopted8000 singleton map retained.

target_switch.scope: Same root, both singleton goals solvable and exact optimal FIRST physical action sets disjoint. All candidates retained; teacher checks follow model action selection.

coverage.deduplication: Exact sorted reduced Fraction tuples; one representative per2/3-number multiset, separately for each singleton target.

control.checkpoint_selection: Existing validation objective only; this suite never selects a checkpoint.
control.scope: Exhaustive finite-domain fitting, not unseen initial-question generalization.2/3-number suffixes are deduplicated across roots. Unsolvable queries remain in distance/reachability evaluation; completion uses every positive-distance solvable query. Local held query goals may occur as training goals or state inputs in other questions.

unreachable.note: Finite surrogate is not infinity; classification never filters planning candidates.

predicted_progress.note: Observed autonomous policy trajectories after action selection; full completion remains the acceptance metric.
